ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark grey to black) across approximately 85-90% of the visible surface area, with high-intensity (white/cream) pixels localized at distal tips and along specific linear abrasions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity cluster located at the far-left distal tip (barnacle colony); smaller, fragmented high-intensity mottling cluster located on the far-right distal lobe; primary fluke body is a monolithic low-intensity dark mass.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow U-shaped central depression with a sharp interior convergence point between the two lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern; left lobe features 4-5 prominent jagged peaks (approx 10-20 pixels in amplitude); right lobe exhibits finer, more continuous serration towards the tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Left lobe exhibits a steep convex upward sweep; right lobe displays a more linear diagonal trajectory with a slight downward curve at the extreme distal tip.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed cluster of roughly circular, high-contrast, three-dimensional pixel structures on the far-left lobe tip; sparse circular white markings visible on the right lobe surface near the trailing edge.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple distinct white linear tracks (rake marks) observed horizontally across the mid-section of the left lobe; 2-3 shorter vertical white streaks on the lower-left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle encrustation on the outer edge of the left fluke; large, irregular white depigmented patch/scar on the right fluke near the distal tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Visible water droplets and spray creating high-intensity specular highlights across the low-intensity dark surface of the left lobe.
